correctness.rationale: Exact enumeration of all 9! injective graph-vertex filtrations yields 510 distinct strong-gradient generators and 2,634 nonempty simplicial faces. A specified fixed 18-bit coordinate-toggle sequence yields 1,314 legal face–coface pairs and precisely one critical zero-cell and five critical four-cells. A complete directed topological sort of 11,538 Hasse incidences proves global acyclicity rather than assuming it. The Morse CW complex has no cells in dimensions one through three, so every four-cell attaches to a point; consequently it is a wedge of five four-spheres. Independent mod-two simplicial boundary ranks agree but are not the proof of integral homotopy.

value.rationale: The 2026 primary manuscript identifies the full-cycle homotopy problem as difficult despite a table of homology computations. The nine-cycle is the next three-periodic test of a possible double-suspension relationship with the six-cycle. This exact integral homotopy classification upgrades known homology to a perfect discrete-Morse certificate and explains a striking contrast: only 36 added faces separate the full complex from a pure complex with a different low-dimensional sphere summand. This is not a numerical recomputation of the known Betti ranks.
